verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on AI agent that reads connected data such as Gmail, Drive, GitHub and Slack. Its docs show it proactively surfacing insights, for example flagging that a release decision conflicts with a draft you shared last week, and bringing results or decisions to you. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of insight/suggestion features beyond single illustrative examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: your dot might flag that a release decision conflicts with a draft you shared last week.
it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents, or GitHub to investigate an issue and prepare a pull request.
ask it to investigate new bug reports in a connected Slack channel and prepare fixes for your review.
